senses.gloss: m. (v. באיש) bad, wrong (of persons and deeds); also ill, sick.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:5">Targ. Gen. VI, 5</cite>; a. v. fr.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:4">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> (prov.) <he>טב לב׳ וכ׳</he> when thou hast done good to a bad man, thou hast done evil (to thyself).
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 115a:15">B. Kam. 115ᵃ</cite> <he>חנן בישא</he> Ḥanan, the bad man.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 75b:13">B. Mets. 75ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דב׳ ליה וכ׳</he> he who fares badly in one place; a. fr.—Pl. <he>בִּישִׁין</he>, <he>בִּישַׁיָּא</he>, <he>בִּישַׁיָּיא</he>.
Targ. Gen. XIII, 13; a. v. fr.—בִּישַׁיָּיא freq. the sick.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 4:6">Koh. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>ומפלגא לב׳</he> and distributes (the apples) among the sick.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:3">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>מבקרא ביש׳</he> (not <he>בייש׳</he>) to visit the sick.—Fem. <cite ref="B00740"><he>בִּישָׁא</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00750"><he>בִּישְׁתָּא</he></cite>
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 37:20">Targ. Gen. XXXVII, 20</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 6:5">Ib. VI, 5</cite>, a. fr. <he>בִּישַׁת</he> constr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 129a:19">Sabb. 129ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ מי וכ׳</he> can bad be good? Y. ib. XIV, 14ᶜ bot. <he>טב לבישתא וכ׳</he> (vinegar is) good for a sore, but bad for a sound tooth.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:1">Lev. R. s. 33</cite>, beg., from it (the tongue) comes the good <he>ומינה ב׳</he> and from it the evil; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="B00750"><he>בִּישָׁתָא</he></cite>, <he>בִּישָׁאתָא</he>, <cite ref="B00746"><he>בִּישָׁן</he></cite>.—
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 28:8">Targ. Gen. XXVIII, 8</cite> (ed. Vien. O. <cite ref="B00740"><he>בישא</he></cite>, corr. acc.); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 7a:10">Snh. 7ᵃ</cite> happy is he who hears (himself insulted) and keeps silence <he>חלפוה בישתיה מאה</he> (corr. <he>חלפוהו בישתא</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) a hundred evils pass by him (he escapes &c.); a. fr.
